nodes.label: Security Policy and Supported Versions
nodes.rationale: 3.x fully supported, 2.x critical fixes only, <2.0 unsupported. Vulnerabilities go through private GitHub Security Advisories rather than public issues, acknowledged within 5 business days.

nodes.label: Operator note: JDBC payload deserialization allowlist
nodes.rationale: The JDBC store deserializes by the class name in the PAYLOAD_CLASS column; loading is restricted to an allowlist auto-derived from discovered @Failover payload packages so only the consumer's own referential classes materialize. failover.store.jdbc.allowed-payload-classes is an additive override for types the scanner cannot infer (e.g. a scatter slice type in another package).

nodes.label: Table-prefix identifier validation
nodes.rationale: failover.store.jdbc.table-prefix and per-tenant prefixes are concatenated into SQL identifiers, so they are validated to contain only letters, digits, underscores and dot-separated qualifiers.

nodes.label: Operator note: multi-tenant strict mode
nodes.rationale: In TABLE_PREFIX mode, failover.store.multitenant.strict=true rejects tenants absent from the configured map, preventing an unconfigured tenant from silently sharing the global store table.
